releases.name: Cats in Wonderland
releases.summary:
Cats in Wonderland is a hidden object game where you need to find all the hidden cats in Wonderland.

Explore the maps, find items to access new areas, and gather the resistance to defeat the Queen of Hearts.

releases.name: Vibe City Islands Architect
releases.summary: The mayor has given you a budget; people need housing, jobs, parks. The city needs a tourism boost, now! It's actually a chill game.. 10 gangs, each with their own radio station. Build for the city, or for your favourite gang.......... You are the architect.

releases.name: Serious Sam: Shatterverse
releases.summary: Serious Sam: Shatterverse is a co-op roguelite FPS for 1 - 5 players. Blast through shifting universes, stack wild boons, bend the rules with run modifiers, and hunt Mental's deadliest forces. Fall fast. Come back louder.

releases.name: Cruise Hantavirus Simulator
releases.summary: What could possibly go wrong on a luxury tropical cruise? Become a mischievous infected rat and spread chaos across a massive cruise ship. Infect tourists, spread panic, unlock new abilities, and watch the outbreak grow.

releases.name: Survivors: Become an Immortal
releases.summary: Survivors: Become an Immortal is an arena-based roguelite inspired by Xianxia fantasy and Five Elements culture. Choose an Immortal with unique abilities to play, battle monsters across randomly generated maps, collect resources, buy things from the shop, craft your own unique build, and survive!

releases.name: Log of Adventurers
releases.summary: A free-to-play text-driven online RPG set on the continent of Alvasa. Learn skills, gather resources, craft equipment, fight enemies, tame creatures, study magic, and record your journey after a great flood.

releases.name: Sycamore End
releases.summary: A short story-driven horror game with a worn VHS finish. Move into the last house on Sycamore Street, unpack, meet the neighbor, and find out why the dog won't go near the attic. After dark, hide in the wardrobe, watch through the slats, and try to get a phone signal.

releases.name: The Girl in the Window
releases.summary:
The town of Hidden Town is scared. Very strange things are happening. Villagers claim to have seen the figure of a girl who looks out from the window of one of the houses. Which is very strange, because that house has been abandoned for 20 years.

The Girl in the Window is Dark Dome's first point and click game that would begin the series of a dark town called Hidden Town surrounded by ancient mysteries. In this escape the room suspense thriller game you play Dan, a curious guy who has entered an abandoned house and has been locked up. You will have to solve riddles and puzzles, open drawers and decipher codes, everything in your power to escape the room in this escape puzzle.

releases.name: DUNGEON AI DRAGON
releases.summary: A text-based MMORPG narrated by an AI dungeon master. Every battle and quest reshapes itself around your choices. Pick a class, raid dungeons, and carve your name into the world's chronicle.

releases.name: DuelX
releases.summary: THE #1 NEW WORD GAMEWord Fall is a challenging, brain stimulating, super fun game for all ages! Race as fast as you can sto spell as many words as possible with your block full of letters. Every correct word will destroy those tiels and new ones will fall from above!Be strategic and go for larger words! More letters means more points! Or clear out some of the small words to shift letters around and spell out the gigantic word you've been eyeing from the start!MENTALLY STIMULATINGWord Fall's fast paced vocabulary based action is great for stimulating the mind and keeping your brain in tip top shape!ONE-TOUCH PLAYSimply touch any tile and drag your finger to other tiles to spell out a word. Designed to be easy to use for all ages!GROW AS YOU PLAYKeep track of your best words and high score to track your performance and push yourself to improve!ELEGANT DESIGNBeautiful graphics with a calming color scheme!

releases.name: MyHiStory
releases.summary: Snail Tale is the story of an adventurous snail ready to conquer extreme challenges. Get the snail to cross over terrains and valley to reach his friend. Collect coins, gold and high energy food pots en-route and avoid getting killed by deadly obstacles. The deadly obstacles come in all form and the list range from : 1. Fence 2. Rotating Blades 3. Poisonous desert Scorpions 4. Reptiles 5. Venomous spiders 6. Cactus of all forms 7. Dead skeletal remains Power-ups • Health Drinks • Magneto • Capsule power • Special Neon Tap and stick to static platform/objects and make a quick move. It’s time to take an adventure home.

releases.name: Saucepanhead II - The Call of Nature
releases.summary: Join Saucepanhead as he recovers from saving the galaxy by taking a trip into the great outdoors, which turns out to be far more dangerous than expected! Find six passcard sections to gain access to a strange industrial facility that holds the secret of the natural world's malicious metamorphosis.

releases.name: Haunted Laia
releases.summary:
A new family has arrived in Hidden Town, but since the day they moved in, they have been harassed by strange presences in their own home, until a few days later they disappeared without a trace. 

What happened? Where are they? Help Laia solve the mystery and reveal the secrets behind her disappearance.
